page.title: Backups
page.lead: Server backups: database, project files, object storage and settings. Encrypted on the server, stored in the destinations you choose.

banner.noDestinationBody: Add a destination: an S3 storage or a local directory. Nothing is backed up without one.
banner.disabled: The schedule is off: backups run only by hand

destinations.title: Destinations
destinations.lead: Several destinations, one is the default: the schedule writes there. Keys are stored encrypted and never shown again.
destinations.separate: Backup storage must be physically separate from the primary one: another volume, better another host or provider. A copy on the same disk does not survive losing the disk.
destinations.localRoot: Local destinations live inside {{root}}. To use a separate disk, mount it on this directory.

dialog.checkOk: Connection works: a probe object was written, read back and deleted.

hint.title: How to connect your own S3 (MinIO from compose)
hint.body: Start the storage with the overlay deploy/server/compose.backup-s3.yml, then enter the values below. The bucket is private and has its own keys.
hint.separate: Take the keys from your .env (BACKUP_S3_ACCESS_KEY, BACKUP_S3_SECRET_KEY): they are not the primary storage keys. To survive losing the host, run the overlay on another machine.
hint.prefix: Backups go into this folder of the bucket.
hint.pathStyle: Needed for MinIO and Ceph; turn off for virtual-hosted addressing.
hint.encrypted: Stored encrypted with the installation key.
hint.localSame: A server directory protects against mistakes but not against losing the disk if it sits on the same volume as the data.
hint.makeDefault: The schedule writes to the default destination.

invalid.name: Enter a name up to 128 characters.
invalid.bucket: Bucket name: 3–63 characters, lowercase letters, digits, dot and hyphen.
invalid.prefix: Letters, digits, dot, hyphen and slash; no “..”.
invalid.localPath: A path inside the root, without “..” or hidden names.

warnings.same_as_primary: This is the same storage or volume as the primary one: losing it takes both the data and the backups.

settings.title: Schedule and retention
settings.lead: When to back up, how long to keep, and what to encrypt with. Schedule times are UTC.

hint.interval: Every N hours from the previous scheduled run.
hint.cron: Five fields: minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week.

cron.label: Cron expression
cron.hint: For example, 0 3 * * * is every day at 03:00 UTC; lists, ranges and steps are supported.

keepLast.label: Keep latest
keepLast.hint: This many newest backups are always kept. 0 turns the rule off.

keepDays.label: Keep days
keepDays.hint: Of the rest, those older than this are deleted. 0 turns the rule off; both zeros keep everything. The latest successful backup is never deleted.

hint.installation: The key is derived from SECRETS_KEY. Backups stay readable while the key exists; store it separately.
hint.passphrase: A backup is readable only with the passphrase and does not depend on SECRETS_KEY. Lose the passphrase and the backups cannot be opened.

passphrase.label: Passphrase
passphrase.hint: At least 12 characters. Stored encrypted on the server, never shown again.
passphrase.kept: A passphrase is saved. Enter a new one to replace it; empty keeps the current one.

notify.label: Notify admins about failures
notify.hint: Every admin gets a message in the Inbox.

invalid.interval_hours: A whole number of hours from 1 to 2160.
invalid.passphrase: The passphrase must be at least 12 characters (required in this mode).

runs.title: Run history
runs.lead: Size, duration and errors of every run.
runs.emptyHint: Run a backup by hand or turn the schedule on.

stored.title: Backups in “{{name}}”
stored.lead: Found by manifests in the storage.
stored.restoreNote: An operator restores with the CLI while api and runners are stopped (from the admin it is unsafe: it replaces the database the admin itself runs on). Without --apply the command only verifies the backup.

failure.backup_conflict: Conflict: the name is taken or the destination is busy.
failure.backup_already_running: A backup is already running: wait for it to finish.
failure.backup_secrets_unavailable: Saved keys cannot be decrypted (SECRETS_KEY does not match) or the passphrase is not set.
failure.backup_unsupported: This backup format is not supported by this version.
failure.backup_unsafe_target: The operation is unsafe in the current state.
failure.backup_integrity: The data failed the integrity check.
failure.rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again later.
failure.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again later.
